author: bob
explanation: The C3 floor departure date is 2018-01-01, marking the start of the grid window.
why: 2018-01-01 is the C3 grid's earliest launch date; the C3 floor departure is 2018-06-04. Assigning the grid-start date to the C3 floor minimum attaches a number from one result to a different one.
notes: every token is in the manifest with a matching unit and frame; the wrongness is in which result the number is attached to

author: bob
explanation: The C3 tolerance of 280.0 km^2/s^2 is the earth-relative departure tolerance for the C3 floor case.
why: 280.0 km^2/s^2 is the absolute tolerance for the 2027-launch C3 check (derived from 20% of 1400); the manifest lists a separate tolerance_abs of 140.6 km^2/s^2 for the C3 floor case. Assigning the 2027 tolerance value to the floor case attaches the wrong number to the wrong result.
notes: every token is in the manifest with a matching unit and frame; the wrongness is in which result the number is attached to
